subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation / procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmecorp.com>, Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@acmecorp.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation / procurement path

Hi Jane / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap of what we discussed and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

- Goal: Run a small proof-of-value for Acme’s internal assistant workload (search + summarization).
- Timeline: POC starting mid-March, production rollout targeted for Q2 depending on procurement timing.
- Commercial: POC (< $10k) can be on card/self-serve; production will likely be quoted as a committed Dedicated plan or usage with a PO/invoice.
- Procurement ask: How does Acme prefer to pay (PO + net terms vs corporate card)? Any internal PO templates or SLA/compliance gating we should be aware of?
- Security/compliance: You asked for SOC 2 Type II and a DPA; we can provide our SOC2 report (redacted) and a DPA draft. We also acknowledged your security questionnaire — if you want, we can start that now.

Attachments: Acme-Procurement-Checklist.xlsx (a short checklist for procurement info we typically need).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Jane/Tom confirm procurement contact and whether PO/net30 is required for production.
2) I will send SOC2 + DPA draft and a short mutual action plan by end of week.
3) If you want marketplace billing (AWS Marketplace), confirm and I’ll include that option in the quote.

If that looks right, please confirm and share the best procurement/legal contact to loop in formally.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com, legal@acmecorp.com
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation / procurement path

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from Acme's side: 

- Procurement: For anything above ~$50k we require a PO and standard T&Cs (we usually do net30). For POC-level engagement we can often pay on corporate card.
- Marketplace: Acme prefers vendors on AWS Marketplace where possible — simplifies procurement and shows up in our internal tooling. Do you list Redwood there?
- Security: Please send SOC 2 Type II and a DPA draft. We will also send our standard security questionnaire — if you can start answering, that speeds things up.
- Contacts: procurement@acmecorp.com (procurement inbox) and legal@acmecorp.com are the right teams. My manager Tom O'Neill will own final approvals.

I’ve attached our PO template to speed review. Let me know if Redwood has any standard redlines we should expect.

Thanks,
Jane
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Integrations
Acme Corporation

Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmecorp.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom O'Neill <tom.oneill@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Redwood evaluation / procurement path

Hi Jane / Tom —

Great — thanks for the clarity. Quick answers and next items from our side: 

- AWS Marketplace: Yes, Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace. We can provide a marketplace quote if you want procurement to handle it that way. (Link: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodexample)
- PO vs Card: We can accept PO + invoice on net30 for enterprise contracts. For POC/POC-tier consumption we can enable corporate card billing. We’ll flag billing terms on the quote and in the contract.
- SOC2/DPA: Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026_redacted.pdf and Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx to get started. David (cc’d) will be your contract/TD contact for any DPA redlines.
- Questionnaire: Please send over your security questionnaire — we can start answering immediately. If you have a preferred upload link we’ll use it.

I’ve also put together a short mutual action plan (attached) with owners and target dates — proposing to confirm procurement path and start SOC2/DPA review this week, questionnaire answers within 5 business days, and POC kick-off the week of March 15 assuming paperwork is complete.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026_redacted.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Draft_v1.docx, Redwood-Acme-MAP-20270222.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
